ocr_text:
BR-12                    BRAKE SYSTEM — Brake Booster

BRAKE BOOSTER
REMOVAL OF BRAKE BOOSTER

[Diagram labels:]
Gasket
Brake Booster
Gasket
Clip
Master Cylinder
130 (9, 13)
Clevis Pin
155 (11, 16)
Hose

kg-cm (ft-lb, N-m) : Specified torque
◆ Non-reusable part

1. REMOVE MASTER CYLINDER (See page BR-9)

2. REMOVE CLEVIS PIN FROM BRAKE PEDAL
   Remove the clip and clevis pin.

3. DISCONNECT HOSE FROM BRAKE BOOSTER

4. REMOVE BRAKE BOOSTER
   Remove the four nuts, and pull out the brake booster.

INSTALLATION OF BRAKE BOOSTER

1. ADJUST LENGTH OF BOOSTER PUSH ROD
   Adjust the length of the booster push rod to provide the
   specified clearance between the push rod and the master
   cylinder piston.
   Standard clearance:    0.1 — 0.5 mm
                         (0.004 — 0.020 in.)
